_comment: Negotiating with a professional before hiring (the contractor). All percents are of the list price of the quote. Every number is an illustration. flex: how far the price can really come down (hidden from the player, with a random part per quote). patience: how many rude moves the professional puts up with. busy: a busy professional is less flexible. urgent: after urgent_days of setup the professional senses the owner is in a hurry.
